factsToCheck: All unit and node titles follow the UPSC CSE Mains Geography optional syllabus (Paper I: Principles of Geography; Paper II: Geography of India); check the wording against the current UPSC CSE notification
The split of each syllabus unit into nodes is an Aspiran study split, not UPSC's; UPSC lists each unit as one paragraph
Paper I spellings in the notification (for example Koppen, Trewartha, Losch, Rostow, frontogenesis) may differ slightly from the printed text; check against the current notification
Paper II carries one compulsory map question on the subjects of that paper (check against the current notification); no separate node is made for it
Hindi titles use standard Hindi geography terms; check them against UPSC's Hindi version of the syllabus
